sql: DO $$ DECLARE x int[]; arr int[] := ARRAY[[1,2,3],[4,5,6],[7,8,9]]; BEGIN FOREACH x SLICE 0 IN ARRAY arr LOOP NULL; END LOOP; END $$;
note: FOREACH SLICE 0 - invalid because SLICE 0 means scalar but target is int[] not int (type mismatch)

sql: DO $$ DECLARE r record; BEGIN FOR r IN SELECT s.t.id, s.t2.label FROM s.t JOIN s.t2 ON s.t2.t_id = s.t.id LOOP NULL; END LOOP; END $$;
note: FOR record IN query with JOIN across two fixture tables

sql: DO $$ DECLARE i int; j int; BEGIN <<outer>> FOR i IN 1..3 LOOP <<inner>> WHILE j < 3 LOOP j := COALESCE(j, 0) + 1; CONTINUE outer WHEN j = 2; END LOOP inner; END LOOP outer; END $$;
note: nested WHILE inside FOR with CONTINUE targeting outer FOR label

sql: DO $$ DECLARE r record; lim int := 10; off int := 0; BEGIN FOR r IN EXECUTE 'SELECT id FROM s.t WHERE id < $1 OFFSET $2' USING lim, off LOOP NULL; END LOOP; END $$;
note: FOR IN EXECUTE with multiple USING parameters ($1 and $2)

sql: DO $$ DECLARE i int := 0; BEGIN WHILE i < 3 AND s.f(i) > 0 LOOP i := i + 1; END LOOP; END $$;
note: WHILE with compound boolean condition calling a fixture function

sql: DO $$ DECLARE i int; BEGIN FOR i IN REVERSE 5..1 BY 2 LOOP NULL; END LOOP; END $$;
note: FOR REVERSE with BY step larger than 1 (5,3,1)

sql: DO $$ DECLARE x int; n int := 0; arr int[]; BEGIN SELECT COALESCE(ARRAY_AGG(qty), ARRAY[]::int[]) INTO arr FROM s.t; FOREACH x IN ARRAY arr LOOP n := n + 1; END LOOP; END $$;
note: FOREACH IN ARRAY where array is built via ARRAY_AGG into a variable (non-null guaranteed by COALESCE)

sql: DO $$ DECLARE i int; BEGIN FOR i IN REVERSE 1..10 LOOP NULL; END LOOP; END $$;
note: FOR REVERSE where lower bound > upper bound would be forward - still valid (body never executes)

sql: DO $$ DECLARE i int; BEGIN FOREACH i ARRAY[1,2,3] LOOP NULL; END LOOP; END $$;
note: syntax error: FOREACH missing IN keyword before ARRAY

sql: DO $$ DECLARE x int; BEGIN FOREACH x SLICE -1 IN ARRAY ARRAY[1,2,3] LOOP NULL; END LOOP; END $$;
